# Original weekly Union P&L qualification

This finite native PostgreSQL fixture composes the installed original 37-component accounting authority with prospective cash, tournament, inventory and ECO evidence successors. It never replays an installed migration in production or seeds a passing financial receipt.

Run `PG_BIN=/path/to/postgresql/bin python3 scripts/dev/test-union-weekly-basis.py`. The existing full weekly accounting activation runner invokes this fixture once. A fresh Unix-socket-only cluster retains SQL and results at its reported evidence directory and is stopped on success or failure. `source-binding.json` binds every input used by the runner. The captured dependencies are exact read-only catalog or accepted-provider definitions, not modeled financial implementations.

The tests invoke original cash admissions, accepted cash settlement, rake banking and allocation, accounting accrual, tournament registration/refund/re-entry/terminal settlement, weekly P&L payment and all four cascade stages. They assert exact ledger amounts, paid invoices, Messenger delivery, weekly summary delivery, notifications, replay without duplicate effects, invoice-failure rollback, original source rejection and a real two-session close/producer lock cycle. They retain original zero-result participants and horses, and exercise open tournament deferral across both boundaries and terminal realization once. Synthetic standings are game input; award and refund receipts come from their original owners.

The first calendar fixture relocates only original evidence event times inside the disposable database to exercise past boundaries; money and ownership are emitted by the actual owners. The raked-hand fixture instead supplies a private clock namespace and timestamp defaults before original requests, without changing any financial function body, value, receipt or hash. PostgreSQL builtin clock OIDs cannot be replaced reliably. The native clock applies only to this disposable cluster. It tests a real 2-chip bank: member gross rake 1, payout 0.90, Union-house retained rake 1, pre-rake club P&L +9/-9, and actual downstream player rakeback 0.10.

Production installation is prospective. Prior rows receive no invented transaction identity or history. A week must begin after both capture fences and have qualified opening and closing populations. Legacy live holdings without original funding remain blocked; mixed/unknown instruments, missing original source receipts, inconsistent ownership, unsupported external stack adjustments, and changing ECO terms within a week remain explicit exceptions. Tournament open entries retain the existing deferred-result convention, not fair value or ICM. Existing Pacific book boundaries and Monday 04:00 America/Chicago invocation are preserved.

This fixture proves local native behavior. Protected CI, merge, installed catalog, published revision and live behavior are separate evidence owned by the delivery task.
